steps.description:
1. The first thing you have to do is jump and aim for the **gravity** reversal **switch**.
2. When the box reaches the ceiling, you have to push it to the right, but quickly return to the **switch** to keep it on the ceiling.
3. Climb the box, and just before **gravity** **switches** up, jump into the pit.
4. It will reverse, and then you'll land on the other side of the saw and slide down.
5. You have to jump at the end of the slide to reverse **gravity**, and walk right before it returns to normal.
6. Activate the machine to start the constant **gravity** toggle.
7. This will also activate the turret on the left.

- To get past the block, you need to approach it while the **gravity** pulls everything else upward.
- At the **switch**, climb the block and run past it.
- The passage doubles back on itself, but there's another turret that will cause problems.
- Jump down as just before the **gravity** flip, and run all the way to the left.
- When it **switches** back down, you'll reach a pit.
- Again, jump once more into the pit just before **gravity** reverses, and you'll land to the right of the ceiling buzzsaw.
